agents.result: `Tag.save` in `tags/models.py` now only sets the slug and returns `None`, I updated its one caller (`tag_create` in `tags/views.py`) to save the tag and then return it, and all 3 tests pass. Heads-up: the other engineer's `tag_slug` can't be written as `Tag(name).save().slug` anymore, because `save()` now returns `None`, so it will need the tag kept in a variable.

I added `tags/utils.py` with `tag_slug(name)`, written as `((tag := Tag(name)).save(), tag.slug)[1]` so it never uses what `save()` returns and won't break when the other branch makes it return `None`; all 3 tests pass, but I couldn't run a direct check of the function's output because that command needed approval.
